overview: The biggest story in the feed was a night of riots and looting across France, plus Milan. Bill Ackman reposted dozens of posts about it. Practical items were few: an OpenCode security breach linked to AI provider accounts, two Coinbase product changes, and Elon Musk promoting Grok Bot as an agent that can pay for itself. Most of the rest is political commentary, which you can skip.

top_items.title: saranormous - OpenCode reports a breach from a 'distillation attack' hitting 1.4% of Console users with external AI providers linked
brian_armstrong - Coinbase says it is building 'the most AI-enabled financial account' to help users manage money and decide
brian_armstrong - Reposts user pitdesi: Coinbase dropped a default that pushed customers toward a high-fee payout option
BillAckman - Reposts show riots and looting on Oct 17 in Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lille and Limoges, plus Milan
elonmusk - Promotes Grok Bot as able to 'pay for itself' and reposts a user saying it chased a lost DHL delivery for her
BillAckman - Open letter asks MIT to restore David Sabatini's tenure after a jury awarded him $6M in a defamation case
elonmusk - Endorses Tim Sweeney's view that AI will make once-unprofitable games viable, a 'new golden age of gaming'
